name: Simran
title: Songs of the Levites
summary: Simran was one of the Levites who sealed the covenant under Nehemiah. He was part of the group that committed to following God's law after returning from exile in Babylon.

keyEvents.title: Sealed the Covenant
keyEvents.description: Simran was among the Levites who put their seal on the written covenant to follow God's law.

keyEvents.title: Commitment to God's Law
keyEvents.description: As part of the community, Simran committed himself to walk according to God's law and keep all His commands and statutes.
